resources.string: Checking which app is serving the text tools…
No app on this phone is serving the text tools. Install Cloud Keyboard — it holds the AI routing settings and the provider key that these tools use.
The app serving the text tools said nothing about its AI routing, so it is older than that part of the contract. Update it.
Type or paste a text, or share one into Cloud Writer
The result lands here, and you can edit it
Nothing to copy — the result box is empty.
One tool is still running. Wait for it to finish before starting another.
Nothing to send — the text box is empty.
Grammar Check cannot run in this build: its prompt is missing from the registry. Nothing was sent, because falling back to the default style would rewrite the text instead of correcting it.
The text tools answered with neither a result nor a reason.
Text Enhance, Grammar Check and Summary each run on their own model. Translate has none to choose: it goes to the translation engine, never to a chat model.
Cloud Writer holds no API key. It names a provider and a model; the app that serves the tools makes the request with its own credential, and only the text crosses between them.
